before.name: contract_render_requests_valid_insert
before.sql: CREATE TRIGGER contract_render_requests_valid_insert BEFORE insert ON contract_render_requests WHEN NOT COALESCE((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM license_grants g JOIN order_finalizations f ON f.id = g.order_finalization_id JOIN order_lines l ON l.id = g.order_line_id JOIN fulfillment_outbox o ON o.license_grant_id = g.id WHERE g.id = NEW.license_grant_id AND o.id = NEW.fulfillment_outbox_id AND f.outcome = 'paid' AND f.mode = 'test' AND o.order_finalization_id = f.id AND o.state = 'pending' AND o.kind = 'render_test_contract_v1' AND o.effect_key = ('grant:' || l.position) AND NEW.input_hash = g.render_input_hash AND NEW.created_at >= g.created_at) AND JSON_VALID(NEW.profile) = 1 AND JSON_TYPE(NEW.profile) = 'object' AND LENGTH(NEW.public_id) = 36 AND SUBSTR(NEW.public_id, 9, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTR(NEW.public_id, 14, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTR(NEW.public_id, 19, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTR(NEW.public_id, 24, 1) = '-' AND LENGTH(REPLACE(NEW.public_id, '-', '')) = 32 AND REPLACE(NEW.public_id, '-', '') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND LENGTH(NEW.document_public_id) = 36 AND SUBSTR(NEW.document_public_id, 9, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTR(NEW.document_public_id, 14, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTR(NEW.document_public_id, 19, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTR(NEW.document_public_id, 24, 1) = '-' AND LENGTH(REPLACE(NEW.document_public_id, '-', '')) = 32 AND REPLACE(NEW.document_public_id, '-', '') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND LENGTH(NEW.input_hash) = 64 AND NEW.input_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND LENGTH(NEW.profile_hash) = 64 AND NEW.profile_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND LENGTH(NEW.canonicalization_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 32), 0) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Invalid or immutable contract evidence'); END
